scope: Miao Chapter 11 (pp. 347-384), the theorems: Gaussian quadrature and its exactness, Tauchen and Tauchen-Hussey discretisation, orthogonal polynomials and the Chebyshev interpolation theorem (Theorem 11.3.1), splines and tensor products, perturbation, projection methods, numerical dynamic programming (value and policy iteration, fitted value iteration, PEA), and the mathematical content of Exercises 1-3.
source: Jianjun Miao, Economic Dynamics in Discrete Time, MIT Press 2014 (draft of 21 April 2013), Chapter 11
